title: Cloud Architect
summary: A cloud architect designs how a company's systems should be set up on a public cloud platform, and sets the rules other teams build within. They are a senior role above cloud and DevOps engineers, agreeing strategy, security, cost and disaster recovery with business and security leaders.
dailyDuties: Design landing zones (the base setup of accounts, networks and guardrails) and reference architectures
Design hub-and-spoke networks, hybrid links to data centres and private endpoints
Set Terraform standards and reusable infrastructure-as-code modules
Assess workloads and plan migration and modernisation waves
Set availability, backup and disaster recovery targets
Review cloud cost and push FinOps practices such as tagging and right-sizing
Agree cloud strategy and security controls with business, security and delivery teams
